checkpoint: Experimental backed parent-memory lease with real DOS compiler execution
exploratory_notes: First/third emulator runs stalled at init because comma-separated Watcom declarations made later DOS helpers near calls to far-returning functions. All declarations now separate, disassembly checked.
Second build refused a signed handle pointer mismatch in trace fixture; corrected int handle.
Fourth owned stalled emulator was explicitly terminated after near/far diagnosis; no user sessions/processes were targeted.
Fifth ran real compiler but restore refused after foreign SETBLOCK reassigned parent MCB ownership. DOS CurrentPDB scoping fixed it, backed by MS-DOS4 allocator source.
Sixth passed78 checks/3 restorations; seventh strengthened partial-growth/CWD/JFT tests and exposed fixture mkdir-existing errno assumption on second round. Fixture now precreates AWAY.
Eighth collision run exposed pinned DOSBox6C fail-existing handle leak. Attribute preflight retains final exclusive creation; ninth passed1386 checks.
Final test uses both segment bytes in patterns and latches any mismatch to avoid repeated4KB patterns or mismatch-counter wrap. Final/cold artifacts only are canonical.
limits: Profile-sized harness parent/client, not production PCPlus bridge, UART, UI, history-consumer or outer-loan integration.
7133B component footprint exceeds existing roughly3KB startup headroom: banked kernel/admission required, not permanent linking.
DOS4+ entry guard; DOSBox8086/FPUoff integrated DOS execution, not booted MS-DOS4 or physical hardware.
Disk-full/short-I/O/corruption/fatal restore, compiler faults/TSRs, same-child repeated leases and asynchronous reentry remain open.
Raw backing file depends on resident metadata; not a persistent crash journal or DOS security sandbox.
CRC16 detects accidental corruption; not cryptographic authenticity.
An intervening-create race on the old emulator exclusive-open error path is not established safe by existing-name preflight.
Full feature/memory co-residency, source startup/EXECUTE under actual parent, package/hardware admission and whole-app parity remain open.
